87
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the March 10, 2006/Phalguna 19, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs; Food
and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests; Food Processing Industries;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
National policy on land use
*281. SHRI PYARELAL KHAN-
DELWAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is no
national policy on land use in our country;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the soil
Management Techniques like nutrient
buffer power concept are not adequately
recognised in the country;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor and how it
affects our foodgrain output;
(d) if not, the details thereof including
the details regarding the change of
agricultural land use;
(e) whether China has harvested more
than 550 million tonnes of foodgrain
compared to our 200 million tonnes of
foodgrain by using abovesaid techniques;
and
(f) if so, the comparative study thereof?
Cleanliness in Government Hospitals
*282. SHRI E. M. SUDARSANA
NATCHIAPPAN: Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE   be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any fresh initiatives have
been taken by Government to improve the
cleanliness level in various Government
hospitals where the situation is dismal;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
FPI in Nagaland
*283. SHRI T. R. ZELIANG: Will the
Minister of  FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any proposal to develop and promote food
processing industries in Nagaland;
(b) if so, the details of steps taken to
implement this proposal; and
(c) if not, what allocation has been made
for the State during the last three years?

88
Leasing out of forest land in Kerala
*284. SHRI N. K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS  be
pleased to state:
(a) the extent of forest land leased out
in Kerala for a period beyond two years
against the provisions of Forest
Conservation Act, 1980 and purposes for
which such land lease has been made;
(b) whether the Government of Kerala
renewed the above leases without attracting
the provisions of Forest Conservation Act
and whether the State Government sought
the permission of the Central Government
for the renewal of lease of forest land which
stands leased out to various purposes; and
(c) how many lease cases have been
signed on or before the expiry of lease
period and transferred to other holders
violating the provisions of FCA in Kerala
and the details of such cases with extent
and district-wise statistics thereof?
Increasing forest cover
*285. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of  ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made any
comprehensive strategic plan for increasing
the forest cover by maintaining greenery in
the country for the next twenty years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what steps have been taken or
proposed to be taken for increasing forest
cover in the country;
(d) the estimated amount to be spent
on this plan and whether Government have
chalked out any plan for the increasing
participation of local people in these plans;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Disbursement of subsidies to BPL,
poor and marginal farmers
*286. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of  CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that main
recipients of subsidy are surplus producing
farmers of five States from where
procurement is done at the prices set by
Government;
(b) if so, whether the disbursal of subsidy
can be improved with a view to ensuring
that BPL consumers/small and marginal
farmers get the intended benefit of subsidies;
if not, the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether the modern Information
Technology could be harnessed to achieve
disbursement of subsidies for the BPL,
poor and marginal consumers?
Production of Basmati rice in
India and Pakistan
*287. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of  AGRICULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Pakistan has
succeeded in acquiring favourable position
in the battle of Basmati rice;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
regain its supermacy in the production of
Indian Basmati?

89
Consumer Helpline
*288. SHRI N. R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of  CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION  be pleased to state:
(a) whether a National Consumer
Helpline has been set up to provide help,
information and counselling to the
consumers on the matters relating to their
exploitation;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government propose to
provide assistance to the State
Governments to start such help lines at all
district levels; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Survey of wildlife in Papikonda Game
Sanctuary
*289. SHRI S. M. LALJAN
